text.price: $1,578 psf, the median resale price over the last 24 months (Oct 2024 to Sep 2026).
text.comparison: Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 12.
text.record: Prices rose 21% between 2021–23 and 2024–26 (adjusted for unit size), against about 18% for developments with similar features in District 12 — about the same as similar developments.

CHIJ Primary (Toa Payoh), about 280 m: 1.6 applicants per place in Phase 2C, 2025. Admission depends on the exact address.

text.answer: Right by an MRT station and a popular primary school within 1 km. Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 12.
